claim: For a fixed problem size, the ground state convergence frequency in quantum annealing depends only on the ratio of the first and second term coefficient parameters, not on their absolute values.
falsifier: The dependence on coefficient ratio can be tested by varying the absolute values while keeping the ratio constant and measuring ground state convergence frequency on a D-Wave QPU for a fixed problem instance.

conditions: QUBO formulation with two coefficient terms
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the specific 42-node problem and coefficient ranges tested; transfer to other problem sizes or formulations is unestablished.

title: Ratio of coefficient parameters–ground state convergence frequency…

claim: The 7Be destruction rate derived from new cross-section measurements yields a predicted cosmological lithium abundance that is ~10% lower than previous estimates, but this reduction is insufficient to resolve the Cosmological Lithium Problem.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by performing BBN network calculations using the reported 7Be(n,p) rate and comparing the resulting Li/H yield to observed primordial abundances; the predicted yield should be ~5.26×10^{-10} with ~10% reduction relative to previous standard rates.

conditions: BBN epoch (temperature range relevant to primordial nucleosynthesis)
reaction rate described by analytical expression (Eq. 3) with specified coefficients
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the specific 7Be(n,p) reaction rate measured at n_TOF and the BBN network calculations reported; transfer to other reaction rates or BBN codes is unestablished.

title: 7Be destruction rate 7Li–predicted cosmological lithium abundance…
